scope: one structural ASSY middle layer around a repeatedly repaired and reissued LRU/SRU chain

source.boundary: ASSY provides a physical grouping without a logistics role. When ASSY separates the system and LRU in ItemStructure, a direct system-to-LRU ItemReplacement link supplies the replacement logistics. ASSY carries no FRT, stock, repair or demand.

delta: Against F01.var01 three-level behavior parent, insert one TYPE=ASSY item between system and LRU in physical ItemStructure; add direct system-to-LRU ItemReplacement with existing E01 removal and fit task, and change description. ItemRepair, LRU-to-SRU replacement, stock, System, Control, mission schedule, seed, horizon and FRT remain identical. This is the same four-table structural delta accepted at lower FRT in G01.var04. Against that reference, only System/Item FRT and description differ.
pre_run_hypotheses: The one ASSY wrapper and direct system-to-LRU replacement row import/export exactly with all 21 authored populated tables; conversion has zero errors and produces valid nonempty SXI, SXO, event log and 72-bin report.

At least two installed LRU failures and aircraft-level LRU demands occur. The removed LRUs expose failed SRUs, consume local SRU replacements, undergo item-specific 0.75-hour SURP and return to LRU stock. Each failed SRU undergoes one-hour direct repair and returns to SRU stock.

At least one repaired physical LRU is issued for a later aircraft-level demand and at least one repaired SRU is issued for a later nested LRU repair. Physical identities must be tracked rather than inferred from aggregate counts.
ASSY occurs in the physical system-to-LRU connection path but is never demanded, stocked, issued, repaired or a maintenance task target. No ASSY failure rate or repair time is configured.

Every installed fault, task resource request, item stock transaction, backorder, mission outcome, 72 System/Stock report bins and terminal state reconciles. The parent comparison is descriptive; identical random times or unchanged aggregate reports are not required for acceptance.
decision_rule: Accept only if the repeated physical LRU and SRU reissue and inert ASSY boundary are observed in one guarded native run, every source/raw/native/report/terminal gate passes, and a separate read-only reviewer replays the evidence independently. Otherwise retain this as a sealed diagnostic and freeze a new version; do not relax these gates after seeing output.
limits: One ASSY position, one aircraft, one base, one LRU/SRU chain, seed 1, 36-hour horizon and local stock/repair only; no ASSY branch, quantity variation, extra repair level, resource scarcity, remote support, PM or explicit CM.
This does not close issue #403's general nested physical replacement boundary, GUI rendering or cross-engine equivalence.
